name: Vaultwarden
description: Serveur compatible Bitwarden, léger et auto-hébergé.
notes: Les clients Bitwarden exigent HTTPS : active le HTTPS local d'Azmo OS (Sécurité), ou passe par Nginx Proxy Manager ou WireGuard.
compose:
services:
  vaultwarden:
    image: vaultwarden/server:latest
    container_name: vaultwarden
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8222:80"
    volumes:
      - {{APPDATA}}/data:/data

en.notes: Bitwarden clients require HTTPS: use Azmo OS's local HTTPS, Nginx Proxy Manager or WireGuard.
